notes: macOS arm64 candidate built with std.crypto from the same source commits as the Windows and Linux pins; it links libSystem only. Qualified on macOS 27.3 with bun test ./server/persistence (20 pass, 2 skip, 0 fail). The linker's ad hoc signature is part of the hashed file, and signing it for release changes the hash. A second build from the same inputs produced a different hash, so this pin records the qualified artifact and does not promise bit-identical rebuilding. Does not replace the Windows artifact in wormdb.lock.json or the Linux one in linux-x64.lock.json.
